_comment: t/4368 (t/4367 parts 2+3): a registry of shared inputs read by more than one ci.yml path-filter group, so a new shared file can't silently slip through one group's filter while covered in another (the #3546 class: tests/fixtures/source-identity-cases.json changed, test-electron SKIPPED, ci-gate treated the skip as satisfied). consumerJobs here are ci.yml CHANGES-JOB FILTER-GROUP NAMES (needs.changes.outputs.<group>), not literal job IDs -- multiple jobs share one group's boolean output, so checking the group is both necessary and sufficient. Advisory only: a match produces a warning, never a failure (t/4367's own tier note; promotion to blocking is a separate T2 change).
